links.outcome: Reader agreement with gold standard with vs without AI assistance in multireader crossover
links.effect: AI assistance significantly improved agreement with the gold standard for general and subspecialty radiologists; general radiologists' Kappa for BI-RADS breast density rose from 50.01% to 81.38% with AI.
links.quote: AI assistance significantly improved agreement with the gold standard for both general and breast subspecialty radiologists.

screen.reason: Empirical multireader multicase study evaluating the impact of AI assistance on radiologist diagnostic agreement and reliability.

primary.practice: AI assistance vs unassisted reader interpretation
